value.rationale: The known exact degree-two fourth moment is blind to real eigenvalue shape, motivating the precise question of whether and how higher even moments detect quadrupole geometry. The new result identifies the first order (sixth), a universal all-even-moment monotonic shape parameter, exact optimal sectoral/zonal forms, and sharp rational first constants. These classify a natural entire real eigenspace, not an ad hoc slice.
